result.reason: The language does not clearly create an effective 30-day non-renewal right for every renewal, because the right may be exercised only “following the Initial Term,” seemingly preventing notice before the first automatic renewal. It also fails to state that non-renewal takes effect at the end of the then-current term. Further, changing the existing bilateral convenience-termination period from 90 to 30 days materially shortens the termination period and associated fee entitlement, which is broader than necessary to fix the non-renewal window. The preferred reminder and price cap are also absent. The margin comment cannot cure these operative-language defects.
